reasoning_trace.value: The paper discusses a retroreflective optical integrated sensing and communication (RO-ISAC) system. It uses orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) and a corner cube reflector (CCR). The system's reflected sensing channel is modeled using both a point source model and an area source model.
The RO-ISAC system integrates sensing and communication functions using OFDM and CCR. The point source model and area source model are proposed to accurately model the reflected sensing channel.
Theoretical and experimental results are used to verify the accuracy of the proposed channel models. The communication and sensing performance of the RO-ISAC system is also evaluated.
The use of OFDM and CCR in the RO-ISAC system enables the integration of sensing and communication functions. The proposed channel models can help improve the system's performance and accuracy.
